title: Breakers
description: Joo In-gong is suddenly dragged into the remake of a game he was playing, Knight Saga:Re. However, something is wrong. Instead of becoming one of the game's known playable characters, he awakens as Shutra, the ninth prince of the Demon Realm—a character who never existed in the original game's story. Granted the mysterious abilities Protagonist Setting Adjustment and Power of Conquest, Shutra must change the game's predetermined story, survive against the powerful Zephyr, and carve out his own path in the Demon Realm.
author: Chwiryong / JDL
